programs.name: Security Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency validating deep security expertise. Covers identity, infrastructure protection, data protection, threat detection, incident response, and compliance.
programs.eligibility: Validated customer references, technical review, AWS-hosted or deeply integrated solution, annual renewal audit

programs.name: DevOps Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and DevOps tooling. Validates that the partner's solution helps customers implement DevOps practices on AWS.
programs.eligibility: Validated customer references, technical review, demonstrated DevOps workflow integration with AWS services, annual renewal

programs.name: SMB Software Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for ISVs serving small and medium businesses. Validates self-service, low-touch onboarding, and consumption-based pricing models.
programs.eligibility: Validated SMB customer references, technical review, demonstrated SMB-appropriate deployment model, annual renewal

programs.name: Data & Analytics Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for data management, analytics, and business intelligence solutions. Covers data lakes, ETL, warehousing, and analytical workloads on AWS.
programs.eligibility: Validated customer references, technical review, demonstrated integration with AWS analytics services, annual renewal

programs.name: Cloud Operations Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for cloud management, monitoring, cost optimization, and IT operations solutions.
programs.eligibility: Validated customer references, technical review, demonstrated cloud operations capabilities, annual renewal

programs.name: Built-In Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for ISVs with native AWS service integrations built into their product as core components, not just deployed on AWS.
programs.eligibility: Validated customer references, technical deep-dive showing native AWS service integration, annual renewal

programs.name: Observability Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability solutions. Validates comprehensive visibility into AWS workloads.
programs.eligibility: Validated customer references, technical review, demonstrated integration with AWS observability services (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenSearch), annual renewal

programs.name: Financial Services Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for solutions serving financial services customers — banking, insurance, capital markets, payments. Validates industry-specific compliance and regulatory awareness.
programs.eligibility: Validated FinServ customer references, technical review, demonstrated compliance capabilities (SOC2, PCI-DSS, etc.), annual renewal

programs.name: Generative AI Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for GenAI and foundation model solutions. Validates that the partner builds or integrates generative AI capabilities using AWS AI/ML services.
programs.eligibility: Validated customer references with GenAI use cases, technical review showing AWS AI/ML service integration, annual renewal

programs.name: Digital Workspace Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for virtual desktop, application streaming, and digital workspace solutions. Validates integration with AWS end-user computing services.
programs.eligibility: Validated customer references, technical review, demonstrated integration with AWS workspace services, annual renewal

programs.name: Healthcare Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for healthcare and life sciences solutions. Validates HIPAA compliance capabilities and integration with AWS health services.
programs.eligibility: Validated healthcare customer references, technical review, demonstrated HIPAA compliance, annual renewal

programs.name: Nonprofit ISV Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for ISVs serving nonprofit organizations. Validates purpose-built capabilities for fundraising, donor management, volunteer coordination, and grant tracking.
programs.eligibility: Validated nonprofit customer references, technical review, demonstrated nonprofit-specific functionality, annual renewal

programs.name: Media & Entertainment Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for media, entertainment, and content solutions. Covers content creation, management, distribution, streaming, and media supply chain.
programs.eligibility: Validated M&E customer references, technical review, demonstrated media workflow integration with AWS, annual renewal

programs.name: Manufacturing & Industrial Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for manufacturing, industrial IoT, and operational technology solutions. Covers SCADA, OT security, predictive maintenance, and smart factory use cases.
programs.eligibility: Validated manufacturing/industrial customer references, technical review, demonstrated OT/IoT integration with AWS, annual renewal

programs.name: Government Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for government and public sector solutions. Validates FedRAMP awareness, compliance with government security standards, and public sector procurement readiness.
programs.eligibility: Validated government customer references, technical review, demonstrated compliance capabilities (FedRAMP, ITAR, etc.), annual renewal

programs.name: Migration & Modernization Competency
programs.description: AWS Partner competency for workload migration and application modernization. Validates that the partner helps customers migrate to AWS and modernize legacy applications.
programs.eligibility: Validated migration/modernization customer references, technical review, demonstrated use of AWS migration tools (MGN, DMS, etc.), annual renewal

programs.name: Lambda Service Ready
programs.description: AWS service-level technical validation confirming the partner's solution integrates with AWS Lambda and demonstrates serverless architecture compatibility.
programs.eligibility: Technical validation by AWS service team, demonstrated Lambda integration in production workloads

programs.name: WAF Service Ready
programs.description: AWS service-level technical validation confirming the partner's solution integrates with AWS WAF for web security and edge protection.
programs.eligibility: Technical validation by AWS service team, demonstrated WAF integration and rule management

programs.name: Graviton Service Ready
programs.description: AWS service-level technical validation confirming the partner's solution runs on AWS Graviton ARM-based processors with demonstrated cost optimization.
programs.eligibility: Technical validation by AWS service team, demonstrated Graviton compatibility and performance benchmarks

programs.name: Amazon RDS Service Ready
programs.description: AWS service-level technical validation confirming the partner's solution integrates with Amazon RDS for managed relational database workloads.
programs.eligibility: Technical validation by AWS service team, demonstrated RDS integration in production workloads

programs.name: Linux Service Ready
programs.description: AWS service-level technical validation confirming the partner's solution is validated on Linux-based AWS instances.
programs.eligibility: Technical validation by AWS service team, demonstrated Linux deployment and compatibility

programs.name: PrivateLink Service Ready
programs.description: AWS service-level technical validation confirming the partner's solution supports AWS PrivateLink for private VPC connectivity without public internet.
programs.eligibility: Technical validation by AWS service team, demonstrated PrivateLink endpoint implementation

programs.name: GenAI SCA
programs.description: Strategic Collaboration Agreement focused on generative AI. Multi-quarter negotiated agreement defining joint GenAI GTM activities, technical integration milestones, and co-investment terms.
programs.eligibility: AWS sponsor (typically GTM or product team), negotiated terms, partner commitment to Bedrock/SageMaker integration or GenAI solution development

programs.name: PE SCA
programs.description: Strategic Collaboration Agreement focused on partner enablement. Multi-quarter negotiated agreement defining enablement activities, training commitments, and AWS support resources.
programs.eligibility: AWS sponsor, negotiated terms, partner commitment to enablement milestones

programs.name: GTM SCA
programs.description: Strategic Collaboration Agreement focused on go-to-market. Multi-quarter negotiated agreement defining joint GTM activities, co-sell commitments, marketing investments, and revenue targets.
programs.eligibility: AWS sponsor, negotiated terms, partner commitment to co-sell targets and GTM milestones

programs.name: Wholesale Marketplace Program (WMP)
programs.description: AWS Marketplace program enabling partners to sell through channel partners and distributors via Marketplace while still capturing Marketplace TCV.
programs.eligibility: Active Marketplace listing, channel partner relationships, Marketplace operations maturity

programs.name: DSOR
programs.description: Distributor Sales Operations and Resale program. Enables partners to sell through specific distributors (TD Synnex, Ingram Micro, Carahsoft) with formalized resale agreements.
programs.eligibility: Distributor relationship established, operational readiness for resale workflow

programs.name: Passport Program
programs.description: AWS partner enablement program providing structured workshops for partners to improve Marketplace operations, co-sell readiness, and AWS partnership maturity.
programs.eligibility: PDM nomination, partner commitment to attend workshops and complete exercises

programs.name: Marketplace Seller Prime
programs.description: AWS Marketplace program providing premium support, dedicated Marketplace advisor, and enhanced visibility for high-performing partners.
programs.eligibility: Marketplace sales performance thresholds, operational maturity, active co-sell participation

programs.name: Direct Deal Exception Pathway
programs.description: AWS program allowing partners to process certain deals outside standard Marketplace flow. Requires monthly audits to maintain compliance.
programs.eligibility: Approval from AWS, demonstrated need for exception pathway, monthly compliance audits

programs.name: Well-Architected Partner Program
programs.description: AWS program for partners who can conduct official Well-Architected Reviews with their customers using the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
programs.eligibility: Certified Well-Architected practitioners, demonstrated review capabilities, AWS approval

programs.name: MPOPP Activate
programs.description: Marketplace Partner Opportunity Program — Activate track. For partners new to Marketplace, providing credits and incentives to land first transactions.
programs.eligibility: Active Marketplace listing, limited existing Marketplace revenue, PDM sponsorship

programs.name: MPOPP Grow
programs.description: Marketplace Partner Opportunity Program — Grow track. For partners with established Marketplace traction, providing larger credit allocations to accelerate revenue growth.
programs.eligibility: Demonstrated Marketplace revenue history, active co-sell participation, PDM sponsorship
